title.zh: 语言模型预训练的泛化动态
title.en: Generalization Dynamics of LM Pre-training (17 minute read)

summary.zh: 语言模型在预训练过程中会在模仿模式和自适应智能之间出现不可预测的切换，这种现象被称为“模式跳跃”。这种行为无法通过标准优化技术纠正，表现为模型容量的竞争，受每个训练窗口中的数据影响。研究人员建议利用这些动态来更好地选择预训练检查点、优化数据选择以实现稳定泛化，并评估预测语言模型行为的指标。

title.en: How the Trump admin gutted the CFTC, ousting enforcers and appointing industry-friendly officials, as Trump family got into crypto and prediction markets

title.zh: 研究：自2023年以来，生物医学论文中伪造引用的比例增长了12倍以上；到2026年初，每277篇论文中至少有一篇包含不存在的引用
title.en: Study: rate of fabricated references in biomedical papers has grown 12x+ since 2023; in early 2026, one in 277 papers had at least one non-existent reference

title.zh: 自2012年开发以来，《星际公民》游戏累计融资已达10亿美元，但仍处于测试阶段且未确定发布日期
title.en: Star Citizen, a video game in development since 2012, has reached $1B in lifetime funding; it remains in alpha and does not have a confirmed release date

summary.zh: 《星际公民》是一款自2012年开始开发的电子游戏，目前已筹集了10亿美元的总资金。然而，该游戏仍处于Alpha测试阶段，尚未确定正式发布日期。

title.zh: 美国执法文件：国土安全部、FBI 等机构在 AI 热潮中引入“反科技暴力极端主义”这一新国内威胁类别
title.en: US law enforcement documents: the DHS, FBI, and other agencies introduce a novel domestic threat category termed “anti-tech violent extremism” amid the AI boom

title.zh: Charter 确认数据泄露，ShinyHunters 声称从其 Salesforce 实例中窃取了 4000 万条客户记录并威胁泄露数据
title.en: Charter confirms a data breach after ShinyHunters claimed to steal 40M customer records from Charter's Salesforce instance and threatened to leak the data

title.zh: Kelp DAO 表示其重新质押的以太坊代币在经过五周的恢复工作后已恢复，此前曾遭朝鲜 Lazarus Group 2.93 亿美元的攻击
title.en: Kelp DAO says its restaked Ether token has been restored after a five-week recovery effort following a $293M exploit by North Korea's Lazarus Group on April 18

summary.zh: Kelp DAO 宣布其重新质押的以太坊代币在经历了五周的恢复工作后已成功恢复，此前这些代币曾在 4 月 18 日被朝鲜 Lazarus Group 攻击，损失高达 2.93 亿美元。

title.zh: Spotify 为高级用户推出包含 650 多篇长篇杂志文章的有声库；免费用户可单篇购买，每篇 $1.99
title.en: Spotify launches a library of over 650 narrated long-form magazine articles in English for Premium users; free users can buy articles “individually for $1.99”

summary.zh: Spotify 推出一个包含 650 多篇英文长篇杂志文章的有声库，供高级用户使用。免费用户也可以以每篇 $1.99 的价格单独购买。

title.zh: Spotify 联合 CEO Alex Norström 为公司扩展至 AI 生成音乐辩护，称“受控”产品优于不受监管的 AI“劣质品”
title.en: Spotify co-CEO Alex Norström defends the company's expansion into AI-generated music, arguing that “controlled” products are superior to unregulated AI “slop”

summary.zh: Spotify 联合 CEO Alex Norström 表示，公司在 AI 生成音乐领域的扩展是为了提供更高质量的受控产品，而非不受监管的低质量 AI 内容。

title.zh: AI 生成的“自行辩护”案件激增，正在民主化美国法律体系，但也消耗了更多的法院资源
title.en: A surge in AI-generated “pro se” cases, or lawsuits filed by self-represented litigants, is democratizing the US legal system but consuming more court resources

summary.zh: AI 生成的自行辩护案件数量激增，这种趋势在一定程度上促进了美国法律体系的民主化，但也对法院资源造成了更大的压力。

title.zh: AI 初创公司如 Altur 如何利用聊天机器人帮助自动化债务催收；YC 在过去六年中孵化了六家债务催收和结算初创公司
title.en: How AI startups like Altur are using chatbots to help automate debt collection; YC incubated six debt collection and settlement startups in the past six years

summary.zh: AI 初创公司如 Altur 正在利用聊天机器人技术实现债务催收的自动化。Y Combinator 在过去六年中孵化了六家专注于债务催收和结算的初创公司。

title.zh: Nvidia 正式退役使用 20 年的 GeForce 控制面板应用
title.en: Nvidia officially retires its GeForce Control Panel app after 20 years, following the porting of all of its major features to the Nvidia app

summary.zh: Nvidia 宣布正式退役其使用了 20 年的 GeForce 控制面板应用，所有主要功能已迁移至 Nvidia 应用。

title.zh: Google Fitbit Air 评测：轻薄舒适时尚，功能强大，电池续航 7 天，比 Whoop 更便宜，但仅限于手腕佩戴
title.en: Google Fitbit Air review: slim, comfortable, and stylish, robust tracking, seven-day battery life, and cheaper than Whoop, but can only be worn on the wrist

summary.zh: Google Fitbit Air 被评为轻薄、舒适且时尚，具备强大的追踪功能和 7 天的电池续航时间，价格比 Whoop 更实惠，但仅支持手腕佩戴。

title.zh: 加州视障用户表示乘坐 Waymo 提供了独立感并避免了人类司机的歧视
title.en: Visually impaired Waymo users in California say riding in a Waymo gives them a feeling of independence and spares them from discrimination from human drivers

summary.zh: 加州的视障用户表示，乘坐 Waymo 自动驾驶汽车让他们感到更加独立，同时也避免了来自人类司机的歧视性对待。

title.zh: Dropbox 创始人 Drew Houston 在担任 CEO 19 年后卸任，转任执行董事长，由 Dropbox Core 的高级副总裁兼总经理 Ashraf Alkarmi 接任
title.en: Dropbox founder Drew Houston is stepping down as CEO after 19 years to become executive chairman, replaced by Ashraf Alkarmi, who is SVP and GM of Dropbox Core

summary.zh: Dropbox 创始人 Drew Houston 宣布卸任 CEO 职位，转任执行董事长。Ashraf Alkarmi 将接任 CEO 一职，他此前担任 Dropbox Core 的高级副总裁兼总经理。

title.zh: 美光科技市值首次突破 1 万亿美元，股价因 AI 竞赛中的内存芯片需求激增 19%
title.en: Micron hit a $1T market value for the first time on Tuesday as shares jumped 19%, driven by demand for its memory chips in the AI race

summary.zh: 由于 AI 竞赛中对内存芯片的需求激增，美光科技的市值首次突破 1 万亿美元，股价上涨 19%。

title.zh: 消息称中国政府机构开始对从事先进 AI 工作的人员实施出境限制，包括阿里巴巴和 DeepSeek 的员工
title.en: Sources: Chinese government agencies begin imposing overseas travel restrictions on individuals involved in advanced AI work, including at Alibaba and DeepSeek

title.zh: 美国航空选择 SpaceX 的 Starlink 为 500 多架飞机提供机上 Wi-Fi；SpaceX 已与联合航空、西南航空等公司签订合同
title.en: American Airlines picks SpaceX's Starlink for in-flight Wi-Fi on more than 500 planes; SpaceX already has contracts with United Airlines, Southwest, and others

summary.zh: 美国航空宣布将为其 500 多架飞机配备 SpaceX 的 Starlink 机上 Wi-Fi 服务。此前，SpaceX 已与联合航空、西南航空等公司达成合作协议。

title.zh: 小马智行报告第一季度收入同比增长 145% 至约 3430 万美元，高于预期的 2170 万美元，并将 2026 年的自动驾驶出租车车队目标增加 500 辆至 3500 辆
title.en: Pony AI reports Q1 revenue up 145% YoY to ~$34.3M, above $21.7M est., and increases its 2026 robotaxi fleet target by 500 to 3,500 vehicles on fast growth

summary.zh: 小马智行公布第一季度收入同比增长 145%，达到约 3430 万美元，超出预期，并将 2026 年的自动驾驶出租车车队目标从 3000 辆提高到 3500 辆。

title.zh: 小米报告第一季度收入同比下降 11% 至约 146 亿美元，为三年来首次季度下滑，净收入下降 57% 至 6.95 亿美元，因全球内存价格上涨
title.en: Xiaomi reports Q1 revenue down 11% YoY to ~$14.6B, its first quarterly decline in three years, and net income down 57% to $695M amid a global memory price jump

summary.zh: 小米公布第一季度收入同比下降 11%，为三年来首次季度下滑，净收入下降 57%，主要受到全球内存价格上涨的影响。

title.zh: 美国网络安全公司 Zscaler 报告第三季度收入同比增长 25% 至 8.505 亿美元，高于预期的 8.354 亿美元，但预测第四季度收入低于预期；盘后股价下跌超 18%
title.en: US cybersecurity company Zscaler reports Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to $850.5M, above $835.4M est., and forecasts Q4 revenue below est.; ZS drops 18%+ after hours

summary.zh: Zscaler 公布第三季度收入同比增长 25%，超出预期，但对第四季度收入的预测低于市场预期，导致盘后股价下跌超过 18%。

title.zh: 消息称高通与字节跳动达成协议，将为 AI 数据中心提供数百万 ASIC 芯片以支持 Doubao 聊天机器人；高通股价上涨 4.48%
title.en: Sources: Qualcomm reached a deal with ByteDance to supply millions of ASICs for AI data centers to support AI agents in the Doubao chatbot; QCOM jumps 4.48%

title.zh: OpenAI 聘请 ServiceNow 首席营销官 Colin Fleming 担任其商业部门的 CMO，接替因健康原因辞职的 Kate Rouch
title.en: OpenAI hires ServiceNow CMO Colin Fleming as CMO for its business segment; he succeeds Kate Rouch, who stepped down earlier this year to focus on her health

summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布任命 Colin Fleming 为其商业部门的新任首席营销官（CMO），接替早前因健康原因辞职的 Kate Rouch。

title.zh: 荷兰政府以“可能对公共利益构成风险”为由，阻止美国公司 Kyndryl 收购认证 IT 供应商 Solvinity
title.en: The Dutch government blocks the acquisition of authentication IT supplier Solvinity by US-based Kyndryl, citing “a possible risk to the public interest”

title.zh: 西班牙表示正在阻止 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 的运营，以调查可能违反赌博法的行为，预计调查将持续三到四个月
title.en: Spain says it is blocking Polymarket and Kalshi as a precautionary measure while it probes possible gambling law violations over the next three to four months

summary.zh: 西班牙政府宣布暂时阻止 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 的运营，作为预防措施，同时对其可能违反赌博法的行为进行为期三到四个月的调查。

title.zh: 消息称 AI 推理提供商 Baseten 正在洽谈以 110 亿美元估值融资 10 亿美元，此前 1 月宣布完成 3 亿美元 E 轮融资，估值 50 亿美元
title.en: Source: AI inference provider Baseten is in talks to raise $1B at a post-money valuation of $11B, up from $5B after its $300M Series E announced in January

summary.zh: 据消息人士透露，AI 推理服务提供商 Baseten 正在洽谈新一轮融资，计划以 110 亿美元的投后估值筹集 10 亿美元，此前该公司在 1 月完成了 3 亿美元的 E 轮融资，当时估值为 50 亿美元。

title.zh: 消息称：Bond Capital 领投 AI 初创公司 Suno 新一轮融资，估值约 50 亿美元，高于去年秋季的 24.5 亿美元；Suno 预计将筹集超过 2.5 亿美元
title.en: Sources: Bond Capital is leading a new investment for AI startup Suno, which would value it at ~$5B, up from $2.45B last fall; Suno is expected to raise $250M+

summary.zh: 消息人士透露，Bond Capital 正在领投 AI 初创公司 Suno 的新一轮融资，此轮融资将使 Suno 的估值达到约 50 亿美元，相较去年秋季的 24.5 亿美元大幅提升。Suno 预计将筹集超过 2.5 亿美元。

title.zh: 总部位于亚特兰大的电商物流公司 Stord 完成 2.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值达 30 亿美元
title.en: Atlanta-based e-commerce logistics company Stord raised a $250M Series F led by Strike at a $3B valuation, up from $1.5B after a $200M Series E in May 2025

summary.zh: 亚特兰大电商物流公司 Stord 宣布完成由 Strike 领投的 2.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，公司估值从 2025 年 5 月 E 轮融资后的 15 亿美元翻倍至 30 亿美元。

title.zh: OpenRouter 完成由 CapitalG 领投的 1.13 亿美元融资，估值达 13 亿美元
title.en: OpenRouter raised $113M led by CapitalG, a source says at a $1.3B valuation, and now processes 25T tokens across 400+ models weekly, up from 5T six months ago

summary.zh: 据消息人士透露，OpenRouter 完成了由 CapitalG 领投的 1.13 亿美元融资，公司估值达到 13 亿美元。目前，OpenRouter 每周处理超过 400 个模型的 25 万亿个 token，相较六个月前的 5 万亿大幅增长。

title.zh: 伦敦初创公司 Perceptic 完成由 Accel 领投的 1200 万美元种子轮融资
title.en: London-based Perceptic, which says its end-to-end AI platform for drug development is being used by top pharmaceuticals, raised a $12M seed led by Accel

summary.zh: 总部位于伦敦的初创公司 Perceptic 宣布完成由 Accel 领投的 1200 万美元种子轮融资。该公司表示，其端到端 AI 药物开发平台已被顶级制药公司采用。

title.zh: Human Archive 完成 820 万美元融资，利用印度家政服务人员佩戴的摄像头训练机器人
title.en: Human Archive, which trains robots using first-person video from 1,000+ camera-equipped caps worn by Indian home services workers, raised $8.2M from YC and more

summary.zh: Human Archive 宣布完成 820 万美元融资，投资方包括 Y Combinator 等。该公司通过收集印度家政服务人员佩戴的 1000 多个摄像头拍摄的第一人称视频，用于训练机器人。

title.zh: 消息称 SpaceX 成功游说五角大楼提高 LUCAS 自杀式无人机使用 Starlink 的费用
title.en: Sources: SpaceX successfully lobbied the Pentagon to pay more for use of Starlink on LUCAS kamikaze drones amid increasing tensions over Starlink's pricing

summary.zh: 消息人士透露，SpaceX 成功游说美国五角大楼，在 Starlink 定价争议加剧的背景下，提高了 LUCAS 自杀式无人机使用 Starlink 服务的费用。

title.zh: SpaceX 文件显示 X 的广告收入逐年下降，X 和 Grok 现有 630 万活跃付费用户
title.en: SpaceX filing: X's ad revenue was $1.8B in 2025, $1.7B in 2024, and $2.3B in 2023, below Twitter's $4B in 2021; X and Grok now have 6.3M active paid subscribers

summary.zh: 根据 SpaceX 的文件，X 的广告收入在 2023 年为 23 亿美元，2024 年为 17 亿美元，2025 年为 18 亿美元，低于 Twitter 在 2021 年的 40 亿美元。同时，X 和 Grok 目前拥有 630 万活跃付费用户。

title.zh: SEC 文件：Quantinuum 在美国 IPO 中寻求筹资 10.5 亿美元，计划以每股 45 至 50 美元的价格发行约 2100 万股，最高估值达 127 亿美元
title.en: SEC filing: Quantinuum is seeking to raise $1.05B in its US IPO, marketing ~21M shares for $45 to $50 each, giving it a $12.7B valuation at the top of the range

summary.zh: 根据 SEC 文件，量子计算公司 Quantinuum 正在美国进行首次公开募股，计划筹资 10.5 亿美元，发行约 2100 万股，定价区间为每股 45 至 50 美元，最高估值达 127 亿美元。

title.zh: 文件显示：Monzo 的“推荐好友”奖励在截至 2026 年 3 月的 12 个月内同比增长 40%，达到 2950 万英镑，属于 1.43 亿英镑营销支出的一部分
title.en: Filing: Monzo reports its “refer a friend” payouts grew 40% YoY to £29.5M for the 12 months ending March 2026, as part of a broader £143M marketing spend

title.zh: 三星消费电子部门工会请求韩国法院阻止主要惠及芯片工人的薪资协议投票
title.en: A Samsung union representing its consumer electronics division says it asked a South Korean court to block a pay deal vote that mainly benefits chip workers

summary.zh: 三星消费电子部门的工会表示，他们已向韩国法院提出请求，要求阻止一项薪资协议的投票，该协议主要对芯片工人有利。

title.zh: 与桑达尔·皮查伊的问答：通过搜索变革重塑信息生态系统，将 AI 应用到一切，以及 AI 何时会取代他成为 CEO 等
title.en: Q&A with Sundar Pichai about reshaping the information ecosystem with Search changes, putting AI agents in everything, when AI will replace him as CEO, and more

summary.zh: 谷歌 CEO 桑达尔·皮查伊讨论了通过搜索变革重塑信息生态系统、将 AI 应用到各个领域，以及对 AI 未来发展的看法，包括 AI 是否会取代他担任 CEO。

title.zh: 中国执行对徐耀的死刑，因其在 2020 年谋杀游族网络创始人林奇
title.en: China executes a man called Xu Yao for killing Yoozoo Games founder Lin Qi in 2020; Lin reportedly sidelined Xu, who helped land the 3 Body Problem Netflix deal

summary.zh: 中国对徐耀执行死刑，因其在 2020 年谋杀了游族网络创始人林奇。据报道，林奇曾边缘化徐耀，而徐耀曾协助促成《三体》Netflix 合作协议。

title.zh: Anthropic发布Opus 4.8，强调更可靠的结果
title.en: Anthropic launches Opus 4.8, saying it's “more likely to flag uncertainties about its work and less likely to make unsupported claims”, at the same price as 4.7

summary.zh: Opus 4.8在价格与4.7相同的情况下，更倾向于标记不确定性并减少不支持的声明。

title.zh: Anthropic完成65亿美元H轮融资，估值达9650亿美元
title.en: Anthropic raised a $65B Series H at a $965B post-money valuation, overtaking OpenAI's $852B valuation, and says its revenue run rate crossed $47B this month

summary.zh: Anthropic超越OpenAI的8520亿美元估值，并宣布本月收入运行率突破470亿美元。

title.zh: YouTube推出AI驱动的高级播客功能
title.en: YouTube launches new Premium podcast features, including an AI-powered recommendation tool, an “Auto speed” setting, and a new on-the-go listening mode

summary.zh: 新功能包括AI推荐工具、“自动速度”设置和新的移动收听模式。

title.zh: Anthropic和OpenAI的编码代理找到市场契合点
title.en: Anthropic and OpenAI seem to have finally found product-market fit with coding agents, which are quickly becoming daily drivers for very well-paid professionals

summary.zh: 编码代理正迅速成为高薪专业人士的日常工具。

title.zh: Meta计划在大客户中嵌入工程师和产品经理
title.en: Memo: Meta plans to embed engineers and product managers inside large corporate customers as part of a new Enterprise Solutions unit to help deploy its AI tools

summary.zh: Meta将通过新成立的企业解决方案部门帮助客户部署AI工具。

title.zh: Mistral加速超级智能开发以确保欧洲技术独立
title.en: Mistral says it is accelerating superintelligence development to ensure Europe's independence from US tech giants, and signs deals to supply Airbus and BMW

summary.zh: Mistral与空客和宝马签署供应协议，推动欧洲技术自主。

title.zh: IBM与Red Hat投资50亿美元启动开源软件项目
title.en: IBM and Red Hat commit $5B to establish a new open-source software model, dubbed Project Lightwell, and will deploy 20,000 engineers globally, supported by AI

summary.zh: 新项目“Lightwell”将全球部署2万名工程师，并由AI支持。

title.zh: Kirkland & Ellis投入5亿美元开发自有AI平台
title.en: Kirkland & Ellis, the world's highest-grossing law firm, is setting aside $500M to build its own AI platform rather than rely on tools available to its rivals

summary.zh: 全球收入最高的律师事务所选择自建AI平台，而非依赖现有工具。

title.zh: Apollo和Blackstone筹集360亿美元购买Google TPU供Anthropic租赁
title.en: Sources: Apollo Global and Blackstone are working to bring additional investors into a ~$36B debt financing deal to purchase Google TPUs for Anthropic to lease

title.zh: 台湾科技公司完成创纪录的145亿美元债务交易
title.en: Taiwanese tech companies have completed a record $14.5B of debt deals so far in 2026, as they race to secure financing to meet soaring demand for AI capacity

summary.zh: 为满足AI容量激增的需求，台湾科技公司加速融资。

title.zh: 企业在印度的全球能力中心利用 AI 内部化创意工作

title.en: Sources: the Pentagon is pursuing funding deals with US drone companies, potentially with equity stakes, to increase domestic production and lower weapon costs

summary.zh: 非洲初创企业开始依赖养老金和本地风投等国内资金来源。

title.zh: Cognition融资超10亿美元，扩展AI软件工程师Devin
title.en: More Devins in More Places (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Devin显著缩短了项目时间并提升了自动化，服务客户包括奔驰和Itaú。
summary.en: Cognition raised over $1B at a $26B valuation, with significant backing from major investors to expand Devin, an AI software engineer. Devin has significantly cut project times and improved automation for clients like Mercedes-Benz and Itaú. Cognition aims to further streamline software development by matching models to tasks while expanding its engineering capabilities.

title.zh: ElevenLabs发布Music v2音乐生成模型
title.en: ElevenLabs Music Generation Model (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型可在单曲中切换音乐风格，同时保持人声和作曲的连贯性。
summary.en: ElevenLabs has released Music v2, a music-generation model capable of switching genres mid-track while maintaining vocal and compositional coherence.

title.zh: Biohub发布蛋白质生物学世界模型
title.en: Biohub releases a world model of protein biology (9 minute read)

summary.zh: Biohub推出了一个开放的蛋白质结构预测、设计和生物发现引擎，包括ESMC、ESMFold2和ESM Atlas，免费向全球科学界开放。
summary.en: Biohub has made its open discovery engine for protein structure prediction, design, and biological discovery available to researchers everywhere. The release includes ESMC, a state-of-the-art language model that has internalized the fundamental properties that govern protein biology; ESMFold2, a design engine designed to transform ESMC's sequence representations into atomically-resolved 3D structures of biomolecular complexes; and ESM Atlas, which makes ESMC's representations navigable across 6.8 billion protein sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures. All three models are freely available to the global scientific community.

title.zh: 分析：Anthropic和OpenAI已找到产品市场契合点
title.en: I think Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit (11 minute read)

summary.zh: 两家公司通过定价策略表明其编码和通用代理产品已找到市场契合点，企业用户支出显著增加。
summary.en: Both Anthropic and OpenAI have started aggressively pricing their APIs. This is likely because they have found product-market fit with coding/general-purpose agent products. Companies spending over $200 per month per user helps these businesses cover their costs much better than charging $10 to $20 per month per user. Coding agents amplify this spending significantly.

title.zh: 使用Codex构建自我改进的税务代理
title.en: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex (17 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI利用Codex在Thrive Holdings开发了一个能够自我改进的AI代理，用于处理复杂的税务申报。
summary.en: Real-world systems often behave differently in production than they do in the lab. Teams often discover these failures after launch, then spend weeks fixing them. That feedback loop is slow and manual. Today, it is possible to build agents that self-improve. This post looks at how OpenAI used Codex to build this type of agent at Thrive Holdings, resulting in an AI that can prepare increasingly complex tax returns.

title.zh: 通过Delta Weight Sync优化TRL中的权重同步
title.en: Shipping a Trillion Parameters With a Hub Bucket: Delta Weight Sync in TRL (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 介绍了一种通过传输变化的模型参数来减少异步强化学习中的权重同步负载的方法，显著节省带宽。
summary.en: The blog post introduces a method to reduce the weight synchronization payload in async RL using "Delta Weight Sync," which transmits only changed model parameters between RL steps, significantly reducing data transfer from gigabytes to megabytes. A Hugging Face Hub "bucket" manages high-frequency object storage, enabling separate locations for the trainer and inference engine without direct communication, leading to substantial bandwidth savings.

title.zh: NVIDIA推出LocateAnything以加速视觉语言定位
title.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything for Faster Grounding (8 minute read)

summary.zh: LocateAnything是一种视觉语言定位框架，可并行解码边界框，提高处理速度。
summary.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything is a vision-language grounding framework that decodes bounding boxes in parallel rather than token-by-token.

title.zh: 推出Apex：专为React Native优化的快速模型
title.en: Introducing Apex: A Fast, Specialized Model for React Native (6 minute read)

summary.zh: Apex是一款专注于React Native开发的编码模型，优化了性能与成本比，目前处于私测阶段。
summary.en: Apex is a React Native coding model trained to build apps by analyzing architecture decisions, fixing framework-specific issues, and reasoning about constraints. While it doesn't match frontier models on coding benchmarks, the optimized model significantly alters the performance-to-cost ratio within its specific domain. The model is still in development. It is now available in a private beta with selected teams.

title.zh: NVIDIA投资1500亿美元巩固台湾AI制造中心地位
title.en: Nvidia bets $150B on Taiwan as Trump's plan to make US an AI hub backfires (13 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA计划每年投资1500亿美元，支持台湾成为AI革命的中心，并加强与TSMC及其他合作伙伴的关系。
summary.en: Nvidia will invest $150 billion a year to make sure that Taiwan remains at the epicenter of the AI revolution. The investment is aimed at cementing Taiwan as the world's tech manufacturing hub for a long time. Nvidia will create a new headquarters in Taiwan to expand its partnership with TSMC, benefit from close proximity to advanced packaging technology not yet available at TSMC's factories in the US, and boost its alliances with other nearby partners. Expanding the AI ecosystem helps Nvidia further its bottom line.

title.zh: 前Google和Apple研究人员创立Trajectory，提升AI反馈循环
title.en: Former Google and Apple researchers launch Trajectory to enhance AI feedback loops (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 这家位于帕洛阿尔托的新创公司致力于开发能够感知和解释物理世界的AI系统。
summary.en: The new Palo Alto-based startup aims to make AI systems that can actually see and interpret the physical world.

title.en: Xcena, whose MX1 chip performs data orchestration and KV cache management directly within memory modules, raised a $135M Series B at a $570M valuation

title.zh: 伦敦初创公司Inherent从隐身模式中走出，获Index Ventures领投的5000万美元融资，致力于结合人类科学研究与AI推动创新

title.zh: Asana以7500万美元收购无代码AI代理平台StackAI
title.en: Asana acquires StackAI, a no-code platform for building AI agents, for $75M as part of Asana's broader AI pivot; PitchBook: StackAI raised ~$20M

title.en: Opus 4.8 (4 minute read)

summary.en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with benchmark improvements, adjustable effort controls, dynamic workflows in Claude Code, and a faster mode that became significantly cheaper.

title.zh: 微软开发新AI模型以加强AI编程领域竞争力
title.en: Microsoft tries to get back in the AI coding game with new model (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 此举旨在提升编程能力，推动AI技术进步，回应行业需求。
summary.en: Microsoft is developing a new AI model to strengthen its position in the AI coding arena. This effort highlights Microsoft's ongoing competition in AI development and its response to evolving industry demands. The initiative aims to enhance coding capabilities and support advancements in AI technology.

title.zh: Anthropic完成650亿美元H轮融资，估值9650亿美元
title.en: Anthropic Raised $65B in Series H Funding (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 公司计划扩展计算能力、研究和产品开发，企业采用率显著提升。
summary.en: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, citing strong enterprise adoption, $47 billion in run-rate revenue, and plans to expand compute capacity, research, and product development.

title.zh: Agent Judge优化长上下文生产代理的评估
title.en: Agent Judge: Solving Long-Context Evals for Production Agents (10 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过搜索、验证和适应改进评估，测试结果显示其在准确性和一致性上优于传统LLM评估。
summary.en: Agent Judge improves evaluations for long-context, production agents by focusing on Search, Verification, and Adaptation. It tackles LLM judges' shortcomings by navigating long trajectories, verifying stateful actions against systems, and updating rubrics based on real feedback. Test results show Agent Judge, especially with refined rubrics, surpasses traditional LLM judges in accuracy and consistency, particularly in challenging scenarios.

title.zh: NVIDIA推出支持多代理的生成式世界模型γ-World
title.en: Multi-Agent World Models (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型支持独立可控的对称代理，并实现从双人到四人设置的零样本泛化。
summary.en: NVIDIA γ-World is a generative world model that supports independently controllable, permutation-symmetric agents and delivers real-time rollouts with zero-shot generalization from two-player to four-player settings.

title.zh: Sakana Labs提出新方法减少深度网络训练内存需求
title.en: For over a decade, we've accepted that end-to-end backprop is the only way to train deep networks (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过将网络前向传播视为扩散模型去噪信号，显著降低训练所需内存。
summary.en: Holding the entire network in memory at once is why AI training is hitting a resource wall. Sakana Labs has found a new way to break the network into blocks and train them independently. The trick was to treat the network's forward pass like a diffusion model denoising a signal. This slashes the memory needed to train deep models.

title.zh: 动态工作流的引入
title.en: Introducing dynamic workflows (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Jarred Sumner 使用动态工作流将 Bun 从 Zig 重写为 Rust，在 11 天内完成了 75 万行代码，测试套件成功率达 99.8%。动态工作流通过将任务分解为子任务并行运行，直到结果收敛。
summary.en: Jarred Sumner used dynamic workflows to rewrite Bun from Zig to Rust, achieving 99.8% test suite success with 750,000 lines of Rust in 11 days. Dynamic workflows involve Claude breaking tasks into subtasks, with agents running in parallel until results converge.

title.zh: SpaceX 几乎完成用 C 编写的内部 AI 训练栈 V1.0
title.en: SpaceX has almost finished writing V1.0 of an in-house AI training stack in C (2 minute read)

summary.zh: SpaceX 的 AI 训练栈利用管道并行技术，精确映射到 220k GB300s，接近裸机性能，速度提升超过一个数量级。下一步目标是用 C 编写推理栈。
summary.en: SpaceX's in-house AI training stack makes heavy use of pipeline parallelism by exact-mapping to 220k GB300s with 800G NICs, getting as close to bare metal as possible. The potential speed improvement is over an order of magnitude. SpaceX's next goal is to write the inference stack in C for simultaneous high-speed RL across a large block of GB300s.

title.zh: MiniMax 预告 M3 模型，采用稀疏注意力机制提升长上下文响应速度
title.en: MiniMax teases upcoming M3 model with new sparse attention mechanism and 15.6X long-context response speed boost (12 minute read)

summary.zh: MiniMax 发布技术报告，介绍 M2 系列语言模型的创新，并预告 M3 模型将采用稀疏注意力机制，使长上下文解码速度提升 15.6 倍。
summary.en: MiniMax has released a new in-depth technical report on the making of its popular M2 series of language models. The report sheds light on numerous engineering innovations and clever approaches. It teases a new sparse attention approach used in MiniMax's upcoming series of models that yields up to 15.6 times faster decode speed at long contexts. MiniMax's upcoming M3 models will make ultra-long-context AI agent deployment economically viable.

title.zh: IBM 推出“Project Lightwell”
title.en: IBM's "Project Lightwell" (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 该项目将建立一个可信的企业清算所，作为安全协调层，帮助企业将安全补丁直接集成到现有的软件供应链中。
summary.en: Project Lightwell will establish a trusted enterprise clearinghouse to serve as a security coordination layer to help enterprises integrate secure patches directly into their existing software supply chains with enterprise-grade validation and lifecycle management.
